announcements.conflict: The shared feature plan has changed. Review the conflict options.

featureHome.title: Start from the graphics feature
featureHome.description: Turn an art or design request into a project-aware rendering plan before choosing an implementation level. The draft is saved for this workspace, with a local fallback.

brief.title: Graphics Feature Brief
brief.description: Record requirements before selecting tools or changing rendering code.

visualGoal.label: Visual goal
visualGoal.placeholder: Describe the desired result and references.

lifecycle.label: Lifecycle and client integration
lifecycle.placeholder: When it appears, changes, and is removed.

artControls.label: Art controls and assets
artControls.placeholder: Required controls, source assets, and authoring rules.

targetPlatforms.label: Target platforms
targetPlatforms.placeholder: PC, console, mobile, XR, graphics APIs…

performanceBudget.label: Performance budget
performanceBudget.placeholder: Frame time, memory, bandwidth, or quality-tier limits.

compatibilityRequirements.label: Compatibility requirements
compatibilityRequirements.placeholder: Render pipelines, engine versions, hardware tiers, and fallbacks.

profile.title: Graphics Project Profile
profile.description: Source-derived engine, pipeline, shader, platform, and architecture signals.

recommendation.title: Implementation recommendation
recommendation.description: Compare implementation levels using the current brief and source-backed project architecture.
recommendation.empty: Save or edit the Feature Brief, then generate a recommendation before implementation.

plan.title: Cross-module implementation plan
plan.description: Dependency-ordered work across rendering, shaders, client lifecycle, assets, and validation.
plan.empty: Generate a solution recommendation, then create the implementation plan.
plan.alternativeFormat: One alternative per line: level | reason not selected
plan.risksFormat: Risks: id | title | impact | mitigation | review gate
plan.compatibilityFormat: One target per line: target | strategy | fallback
plan.statusNotePlaceholder: Add progress, blockers, or review notes.
plan.completionPlaceholder: One observable completion condition per line.
plan.conflictDescription: Another window or teammate saved a newer plan. Review the shared version before continuing.
plan.mergeConflicts: {{count}} field conflicts require a choice before saving.

capabilities.featurePlanningDescription: Structure requirements, compare implementation levels, and define acceptance criteria.
capabilities.sourceAnalysisDescription: Inspect rendering code, shaders, client integration, and asset contracts without a capture tool.
capabilities.assetValidationDescription: Inspect Unity bundles or APK assets through an AssetStudio capability when it is installed.
capabilities.assetValidationReason: AssetStudio is optional. Source-level asset contracts and feature planning remain available.
capabilities.assetRoadmap: AssetStudio integration will progressively add texture, mesh, material, renderer, memory, and dependency audits.
capabilities.assetLoadFailed: The artifact could not be loaded.
capabilities.assetInventoryFailed: The asset inventory could not be loaded.
capabilities.runtimeGpuDescription: Inspect captures, events, pipeline state, shaders, and resources through an optional runtime provider.
capabilities.runtimeUnavailable: RenderDoc for VS Code is not required for Graphics Workspace. Install a runtime provider only when capture-level GPU evidence is needed.
capabilities.mappingIdentifier: Shader, pass, draw, or resource identifier
capabilities.runtimeOptionalDescription: Feature planning, source analysis, shader authoring, pipeline design, and asset contracts continue to work. Capture actions appear only after a compatible provider is available.
